observations.says: the housemaid counted the strokes of the hall clock as the shot came: nine
the hall clock was right that evening: set that morning by the church
the gardener took the time from the stable clock, and it is a quarter of an hour slow: his quarter to nine was nine by the hall clock
the gardener was honest, and wrong: the time he gave was the slow clock's
he left the library at ten to nine, by the hall clock
the shot came at nine by the same clock, ten minutes after he left
the shot was aimed at Sir Giles's chair
